data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the to-do application","i_want":"to create a new task with its required fields","so_that":"I can record work I need to do and track it in my personal task list","business_description":"Users need to add tasks to their personal task list. Each task carries a title, description, status, priority, creation date, due date, last updated date and completion date. The backend stores tasks in a new table in the existing persistence database. The frontend provides a form to enter the task fields and shows a success or error message after the save.","business_value":"Users can capture their work items in one place, with the fields needed to the title is reported as mandatory, and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A user enters a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The task is rejected and an error message is shown, and no task is saved"},{"given":"The backend create request fails because of a server or database error","when":"The frontend receives the failure","then":"The frontend shows an error message and does not show the task as saved"},{"given":"A task is created with a Status of Open or In Progress or Completed, or a Priority of Low, Medium or High","when":"The task is saved","then":"The stored Status and Priority values are one of the allowed values"},{"given":"A task is created","when":"The task is saved","then":"Its Completion Date is empty until the task is completed"}],"edge_cases":["Title containing only spaces: the PRD says the title must be non-empty; whether whitespace-only titles are rejected is not stated and needs confirmation.","Due Date equal enter it.","A Status or Priority value outside the allowed list is rejected by the backend.","The form does not state default values for Status and Priority when the user does not choose one; this is
